title: Central Hudson Heat Pump Rebates 2026
desc: NYS Clean Heat (run by Central Hudson) pays up to $12,000 (Weatherized Tier, old system removed) for a whole-home heat pump. What stacks, what ended, and EmPowe
lead: Heat pump rebates for homeowners in the mid-Hudson Valley, checked against Central Hudson and NYSERDA on October 3, 2026.
short: Short answer: NYS Clean Heat (run by Central Hudson) pays up to $12,000 (Weatherized Tier, old system removed) for a whole-home heat pump. It is one rebate, taken off your contractor’s bill. Lower-income households can get more through EmPower+. The federal 25C/25D tax credits ended December 31, 2025.

These are single-family amounts. Apartments and homes under 1,000 sq ft get about half ($2,000 / $3,500 / $1,000, or $4,000 / $6,000 in the Weatherized Tier). Central Hudson’s table does not list a separate DAC column, and its cap is 85% of cost.

Clean Heat is the Central Hudson rebate, so never add the two together. Clean Heat is capped at 70% of cost (85% in a DAC). There is no separate federal HEAR cheque: New York delivers it through EmPower+. The federal 25C/25D tax credits ended December 31, 2025.

EmPower+ (NYSERDA) is for lower-income owners and renters of 1–4 family homes. Low-income households can get upgrades at no cost, up to $12,000 upstate or $14,000 downstate. Moderate-income households get 50% of the cost covered, up to $6,000 upstate or $7,000 downstate. Heat pumps can add more on top. Income limits depend on your county and household size.

Comfort Home (NYSERDA) pays $2,500 or $3,000 toward an air-sealing and insulation package, plus $2,000 more if you add windows. It works through Comfort Home contractors in participating counties, so check that yours is covered.

faq: How much is the Central Hudson heat pump rebate?
NYS Clean Heat (run by Central Hudson) pays up to $12,000 (Weatherized Tier, old system removed) for a whole-home heat pump. Partial systems and apartments get less.
Can I add NYS Clean Heat on top of my utility rebate?
No. NYS Clean Heat is the rebate Central Hudson pays, so there is only one heat pump rebate from your utility. Income-eligible households may get more through EmPower+.
Is the federal tax credit still available for heat pumps?
No. The federal 25C home-improvement credit and 25D clean-energy credit ended for anything installed after December 31, 2025.
